title: feat(ui): Display menu quality preset, ground shadow, ambient occlusion and Look at a work plane
body:
Stacked on #2835 (merge #2835 first).

## What changed

- The Graphics group of the Display menu has four new rows:
  - "Performance" and "Quality": the quality presets (one choice).
  - "Ground shadow": a soft shadow of the model on the floor.
  - "Ambient occlusion": darker shading in the corners of the model.
- The Look at group has a new entry: "Look at a work plane".
- Each entry has a tooltip. Each entry is view state. No entry queues a command.
- A preset sets the two switches. "Performance" sets the two off. "Quality" sets the two on.
- The menu shows the active preset. The active preset is derived from the switches. If the user changes one switch, no preset is active.
- The two switches are saved in the per-user `view.json`. An old file without the keys loads them off. The default is off, so the view of #2818 does not change.
- Ground shadow: the model bodies are projected straight down on the floor (`floor::floor_z`). The footprint is sampled on a grid, blurred, and drawn as blended triangles (`ground_shadow`). The draw list has the new step `Pipe::GroundShadow`, after the model and before the stock.
- Ambient occlusion: each model vertex gets one baked value (`occlusion`). The value is the share of short rays over the face that meet the body again. The draw list has the new step `Pipe::FacesOccluded`. It is the face shader with the baked value on its light. The values are a second vertex buffer. The model vertex buffer does not change.
- The shadow data and the occlusion data are cached (`shade_cache`):
  - The shadow key is the facets and the shown pose of each body, and the floor height.
  - The occlusion key is the facets of one body. A moved body keeps its values.
  - A switch that is off builds nothing. A still frame builds nothing.
- Wireframe draws no lit face and no shadow. The two switches are disabled in Wireframe. They keep their values, and their tooltip says why.
- No entry is hidden on wasm. The two passes are vertex buffers and alpha blending in the one wgpu pass that the two shells share. They use no texture.
- "Look at a work plane" arms one click on an origin axis in the view. The view turns to face the plane of that axis: Z gives XY, X gives YZ, Y gives ZX. A click on the origin point gives the XY plane. The origins are the work offsets (WCS) and the world origin. The view does not pan or zoom. A miss changes nothing and says so.
- `world_verts` moved from `egui_app/world.rs` to the new `egui_app/world_verts.rs`. The code is the same. `world.rs` was at 392 lines and the new scene data put it past 400.

## Cause

This is new work that the maintainer asked for in #2818. #2834 is the part that #2835 does not include.

## Screenshots

`examples/guide-workholding.camproj`. The stock and the toolpaths are hidden, so that the model shows.

| Before ("Performance") | After ("Quality") |
|---|---|
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2834/before-performance.png) | ![after quality](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2834/after-quality.png) |

| "Ground shadow" only | "Ambient occlusion" only |
|---|---|
| ![shadow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2834/after-ground-shadow.png) | ![occlusion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2834/after-ambient-occlusion.png) |

| The Display menu | After "Look at a work plane", a click on the X axis of G54 |
|---|---|
| ![menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2834/after-display-menu.png) | ![look at](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/pr-screenshots/issue-2834/after-look-at-yz-plane.png) |

The screenshots come from the off-screen harness of the guide images, on a software GPU. They are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No image is in this branch.

## Tests

Pins (all new, all green on the head):

- `ui::draw_list::tests` (3 new tests): the draw list with the shadow pass and with the occlusion pass, on and off.
  - `the_ground_shadow_pass_draws_after_the_model_and_before_the_stock`
  - `the_occlusion_pass_takes_the_model_face_slot`
  - `the_longest_draw_list_holds_each_pass`
- `egui_app::tests::display_quality` (8 tests): the menu.
  - `each_quality_switch_sets_its_field_and_shows_the_check`
  - `a_preset_sets_its_switches_and_one_changed_switch_leaves_no_preset`
  - `wireframe_disables_the_two_switches_and_keeps_their_values`
  - `the_quality_switches_are_kept_in_the_view_file`
  - `look_at_turns_the_view_to_face_a_picked_work_plane`
  - `a_click_on_the_origin_point_gives_the_xy_work_plane`
  - `look_at_a_plane_away_from_each_axis_changes_nothing_and_says_so`
  - `arming_one_look_at_pick_disarms_the_other`
- `shade_cache::tests` (4 tests): the counter tests and the changed-input tests.
  - `a_still_frame_builds_no_shadow_data_and_a_moved_body_builds_again`
  - `a_still_frame_builds_no_occlusion_data_and_new_facets_build_again`
  - `switches_that_are_off_build_no_shade_data`
  - `the_scene_digest_follows_the_shade_data`
- `occlusion::tests` (3 tests), `ground_shadow::tests` (3 tests): the data, with degenerate input.
- `look_at_plane::tests` (2 tests), `display_quality::tests` (1 test).
- `gpu_render::the_ground_shadow_darkens_the_ground_and_not_the_model` and `gpu_render::the_occlusion_pass_darkens_model_faces_only`: a real GPU pass. They compile the new shader stages.
- `view_file::the_shading_switches_round_trip_and_an_old_file_loads_them_off` (`camcraft-app`).

Red before the change: yes. The pins name new items, so they did not compile on the unchanged head of #2835 (`ui lib: FAIL, compile error`). The mutation checks below show that each guard is pinned.

Mutation results. For each row the guard was broken, the pin went red, the guard was restored, and the pin went green. 27 of 27 went red.

| Broken guard | Red test |
|---|---|
| `plan_with`: no ground shadow step | `the_ground_shadow_pass_draws...`, `the_longest_draw_list...` |
| `plan_with`: ground shadow in wireframe | `the_ground_shadow_pass_draws...` |
| `plan_with`: occlusion data of a wrong length is read | `the_occlusion_pass_takes...` |
| `plan_with`: no occluded face pass | `the_occlusion_pass_takes...`, `the_longest_draw_list...` |
| `plan_with`: the shadow step ignores its switch | `gpu_render::the_ground_shadow_darkens...` |
| `plan_with`: the occluded step ignores its switch | `gpu_render::the_occlusion_pass_darkens...` |
| `QualityPreset::apply` does not set the occlusion switch | `a_preset_sets_its_switches...`, `each_preset_has_its_own_words...` |
| menu: a preset is not written to the file | `the_quality_switches_are_kept...` |
| menu: Wireframe leaves the switches enabled | `wireframe_disables_the_two_switches...` |
| `state_view`: the shadow switch is not loaded | `the_quality_switches_are_kept...` |
| `state_view`: the occlusion switch is not written | `the_quality_switches_are_kept...` |
| `view.rs`: no serde default for the new key | `view_file::the_shading_switches_round_trip...` |
| `shade_cache`: the shadow key ignores the pose | `a_still_frame_builds_no_shadow_data...` |
| `shade_cache`: the shadow is built on each frame | `a_still_frame_builds_no_shadow_data...` |
| `shade_cache`: the occlusion is built on each frame | `a_still_frame_builds_no_occlusion_data...` |
| `shade_cache`: a switch that is off still builds | `switches_that_are_off_build_no_shade_data` |
| scene digest: the shade data is not read | `the_scene_digest_follows_the_shade_data` |
| `shell.rs`: the armed plane click is not sent | the two `look_at_*plane*` tests |
| `look_at_plane`: the origin point does not give Z | `a_click_on_the_origin_point_gives...` |
| `look_at_plane`: a reversed WCS axis is not applied | `the_plane_normal_follows_the_rotation...` |
| `look_at_plane::arm` keeps the face pick armed | `arming_one_look_at_pick_disarms_the_other` |
| `occlusion`: no ray meets the body | `the_floor_is_darker_at_the_wall...` |
| `occlusion`: the ray origin is not lifted off its face | `a_convex_body_is_open_at_each_vertex` |
| `ground_shadow`: no blur | `a_box_on_the_floor_shades_its_footprint...` |
| `ground_shadow`: the mesh is not on the floor | `a_body_above_the_floor_casts...` |
| shader: `fs_occluded` does not read its value | `gpu_render::the_occlusion_pass_darkens...` |
| shadow pipeline: no depth test | `gpu_render::the_ground_shadow_darkens...` |

Changed tests (the change explains each):

- `layout_window_display_menu` lists the five new rows of the menu.
- `draw_list_tests.rs` and `view_file.rs` build `Counts` and `ViewPrefs` with `..Default::default()`. Each structure has two new fields.

Original author validation: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` was green (21 steps, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` was clean. The review-fix results below replace these results for the current head.

One of three gate runs failed: the `ui lib` process ended with `SIGSEGV` two seconds after the software GPU driver printed its device warnings. No test failed. The two other runs and one more run of the suite were green (1314 passed) on the same code. The new lib tests make no GPU device.

## Review fixes

Head: `615584eedad2e550aa6fa8b4092085322fbdf1f0`.

The picked face normal now uses `setup_align::view_pose`, as drawing and picking do. This includes the active setup alignment.

`egui_app::tests::display_menu::look_at_uses_the_face_normal_in_the_active_setup_frame` pins a setup rotated 90 degrees about X. It asserts the shown -Y normal and the camera direction after the click.

Mutation check: the test failed with normal `[0, 0, 1]` when `model::transform_of` replaced `setup_align::view_pose`. The restored code passed with the expected -Y normal.

Final-head validation:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. Of 21 steps, 19 passed and 2 failed (`ui lib` and `ui shell`).
- The UI library had 1308 passed, 7 failed, and 7 ignored tests. Six report tests failed with `No adapter found`. `headless_run_succeeds` reported `metal found no adapters`.
- The shell suite had 20 passed and 1 failed test. `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero` returned 1 instead of 0 with the same renderer.
- `gpu_render` reported 14 passed and 1 ignored test. Device tests returned early because no adapter was available. GPU rendering remains unverified here.
- The new rotated-setup pin passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: GREEN. All 184 selected steps passed in 21.0 minutes. The changed `app::view` reached all app heavy targets. The gate also confirmed the expected failure for known-fail #1950.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN in 1 minute 1 second.

## Goldens moved

None. No `.nc` file, no `.cl` file and no snapshot PNG changed against #2835.

## Not exercised

- The wasm build did not run. The two passes use only code that the two shells share.
- No frame time measurement on a large model. With the two switches off ("Performance"), a frame builds nothing and draws the list of #2835.
- With a switch on, a still frame builds no data. It does these reads more: the scene digest reads the shade values, and the shadow reads `floor::floor_z` one more time. `floor_z` walks the facets on each call today (the grid calls it too).
- The first frame after "Ambient occlusion" goes on bakes each body on the UI thread. The time was not measured on a large model.
- The occlusion is a value for each vertex. A large flat triangle shows a linear ramp between its corners, not a narrow dark line in the corner. A fine mesh shows the corner well. `docs/decisions/2834-display-quality-shadow-ao.md` has the alternatives.
- The values are for one body alone. A part does not darken the vise that holds it.
- The shadow is faint on the dark viewport ground (see the screenshots). It was not looked at on a light theme.
- A lathe view (the floor stays at world Z=0).
- Construction planes. The document has no construction plane entity. "Look at a work plane" takes the WCS origins and the world origin.
- The pixel snapshots (release lane). The defaults are off, so the viewport goldens of #2835 do not change.
- No person used the menu in the real window.

## Overlaps

- #2835 (parent): this PR changes `draw_list::plan` (now `plan_with` with the switches), `View3D::render_with`, `display_menu::entries`, `ViewPrefs`, `State::persist_view` and `look_at::arm`. It is stacked for that reason.
- #2931 ("Wireframe, see-through", also stacked on #2835) changes `draw_list::plan`, `View3D::render_with`, the display mode list and `view_pass.rs`. Whichever merges second refreshes. That refresh must read the new mode as a wireframe mode in three places: `draw_list::plan_with`, `shade_cache::collect` and `display_menu::quality`.
- #2893, #2817, #2786, #2773, #2763, #2714, #2678, #2554 touch `state.rs`, `egui_app/mod.rs`, `egui_app/tests.rs`, `lib.rs` or `shell.rs` in other functions (a field, a `mod` line). Whichever merges second refreshes.

No new command, so no MCP tool is owed. Decision record: `docs/decisions/2834-display-quality-shadow-ao.md`.

Effort: high

Changelog: The viewport Display menu has the quality presets "Performance" and "Quality", the switches "Ground shadow" and "Ambient occlusion", and "Look at a work plane" (one click on an origin axis turns the view to face its plane). The switches are kept between sessions.

Fixes #2834
